normalize_tensor_range: normalize a torch tensor to the range [-1.0, 1.0] using min-max normalization
normalize_tensor_custom_range: normalize a torch tensor to a custom range [min, max] with specified min and max values
normalize_tensor_per_dimension: normalize a torch tensor along a specific dimension using amin and amax
normalize_tensor_flat_constant: normalize a torch tensor where all values are close to each other by filling with min value
test_normalize_function: test the normalize function with various tensor shapes and dimension parameters
